fix: rate keeps the per-pool sums as they are (2026-11-26, regression test test_rate_keeps_fractional_events_such_as_gain_sums); gain_per_proposal is recomputed from the block checkpoints that produced the original result. The original file is not modified.
metric: gain_per_proposal = sum of (accepted x population delta) / candidates
